· MACD histogram trajectory (-154.9400→-131.4519): improving but still negative, weakness persists

· Volume ratio (0.51x): low confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis: downtrend continues, maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of clear buy signals
